dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Moderate concave curvature on the trailing edge measured from the posterior base to the apex point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Narrowly acute apex with a small radius of curvature at the terminal morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Gradual convex ascent at approximately 35 degrees relative to the longitudinal body axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.15:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple distinct notches and irregular indentations along the trailing edge of the dorsal fin; extensive, irregular white/light-gray depigmented patch covering approximately 40% of the lateral fin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique mottled or marbled pigmentation pattern concentrated on the upper portion of the dorsal fin.
